name: Generate a Song from a Form (Tunova)
description: A hosted n8n Form collects a text prompt, then Tunova generates an original Suno AI song (v5.5) and returns the audio URL. Core HTTP node - runs on any n8n. Free API key at tunova.ai.

setup: "On form submission" (formTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.

Workflow secret TUNOVA_API_KEY: api.tunova.ai API credential header value (for example "Bearer <key>"; rename the header if the API expects another one) for api.tunova.ai (Authorization: <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: The original started from a form submission; pass the form fields as run inputs.
"Tunova: start generation" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Wait for render (~2 min)" paused the original (120 seconds); Yantra has no delay node, so this step passes data straight through.
"Wait for render (~2 min)" (wait): Wait/delay is a soft passthrough; add a schedule or external delay if timing matters.
"Tunova: get result" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Tunova: get result": a request field used $('OtherNode'); on Yantra $() resolves via the named upstream map when that node ran earlier, else the immediate upstream - check that expression.
